stories.title: Mold record-breaker Sean Conway publishes 420-page guide to iron-distance triathlon
stories.summary: Mold endurance adventurer Sean Conway, who set a world record in 2023 by completing 105 iron-distance triathlons in 105 days around Flintshire, has written a 420-page guide for people taking on their first. stories.title: More people in north Wales turning to dementia support pathway, health board says
stories.summary: More people in north Wales are getting help with dementia through the North Wales Memory Support Pathway, with use of its peer support services more than doubling in the past year. stories.title: Assaults on shop workers rise as abuse and threats fall slightly, union survey says
stories.summary: Twelve per cent of shop workers say they were assaulted at work in the past year, up three percentage points on last year, according to a survey by the retail union Usdaw. stories.title: Man charged over burglaries and car thefts including offences in Buckley and Marford
stories.summary: A man has been charged in connection with a series of burglaries and car thefts, including offences in Buckley and Marford. stories.title: Flintshire meets recycling target but £1m fine still looms
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council still has a Welsh Government fine of more than £1 million hanging over it for missing a statutory recycling target.
